versions.subject: Iscsicpl UAC Bypass + Generic Rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image: C:\Windows\SysWOW64\iscsicpl.exe
filter:
    ImageLoaded|contains|all:
        - 'C:\Windows\'
        - 'iscsiexe.dll'
condition: selection and not filter
